messages:
Nora (AE): Heads-up: MediLedger wants a Private deployment POC but security insists on FIPS-validated TLS endpoints and an IP allowlist they control. They asked PrivateLink vs peering guidance, a minimal firewall snippet, and a 2-week POC cost. Can we make a sharply prescriptive note for their network team?

Ike (NetEng): Short: PrivateLink = faster, less routing, endpoint SGs. Peering/TGW = preserves client src IPs and lets them egress via a static EIP (best for strict IP allowlists + audit). FIPS requirement pushes toward peering + customer-managed NAT/EIP unless they accept app-level mutual auth.

Lina (Solutions): Timeline: PrivateLink validation 1 business day if no org blockers. Transit/peering + EIP plan needs change window + route approvals, estimate 3-5 business days.

Cam (Security): For the questionnaire: we can support mTLS and provide certificate rotation docs. We do not operate FIPS-validated endpoints by default. If they need FIPS endpoints, they must front Redwood with their own FIPS-conformant NAT LB or we run peering + their egress.

Ike (NetEng): Firewall snippet (customer side):
```
# Allow app subnets -> PrivateLink ENIs (temporary POC allowlist)
allow tcp from <app-subnet-cidr> to <vpce-enis> port 443
# DNS + NTP
allow udp from <app-subnet> to <dns-resolver> port 53
allow udp from <app-subnet> to 0.0.0.0/0 port 123
# For peering w/ static EIP (preferred for IP allowlist)
allow tcp from <app-subnet-cidr> to <static-egress-eip> port 443
```
Note: We'll provide service name + AWS account IDs. We can also provide an ENI IP snapshot for the POC window but it is ephemeral.

Lina (Solutions): Cost estimate (2-week, ~12k req/day, ~160GB):
- AWS PrivateLink data processing ~ $0.01-$0.03/GB -> ~$2-$5.
- Endpoint hours small, <$100 depending on AZs.
- Redwood POC support/ops: $1k-$3k.
- If customer requests peering + dedicated NAT EIP, include NAT/EIP costs and potential cross-AZ transfer.

HandoffBot: Created ticket POC-9977 assigned to Ike for connectivity validation; validation window Wed 09:30-10:00.

Cam (Security): Deliverables for audit: short-lived connection log sample (redacted), cert fingerprints, and a cert rotation schedule. That usually clears most RFP checks for a limited POC.

Nora (AE): I'll propose PrivateLink first (fast) and note peering with egress EIP as the compliant path. I'll attach the firewall snippet and cost range to their SOW. Thanks all :pray:
